newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products rise on crude, may fall on supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products rise on crude, may fall on supply.

text.p: NWE oil products rose slightly on Thursday after crude's gallop higher.
Gasoline barges rose $1 due to strength in U.S. markets, offsetting sluggish local demand.
Naphtha jumped after crude's recent gains. End-users said cash deals were done at a discount to swaps prices.
Gas oil gained nearly $4 a tonne on the back of stronger IPE futures and steady to very slightly easier premiums.
High sulphur fuel oil rose slightly with crude. But storage levels are high in ARA, and external supply good.
